method.name: Expression normalization, PCA, exact neighbors and UMAP
method.citation: Wolf FA, Angerer P, Theis FJ. SCANPY. Genome Biol. 2018;19:15. doi:10.1186/s13059-017-1382-0; Jolliffe IT, Cadima J. Principal component analysis: a review and recent developments. Phil Trans R Soc A. 2016;374:20150202. doi:10.1098/rsta.2015.0202; McInnes L, Healy J, Melville J. UMAP. 2018. doi:10.48550/arXiv.1802.03426. Variance ranking and PCA initialization are ClonoLoom choices.

rules.curveFit: 300 points in [0,3]; Levenberg–Marquardt; a=b=1; 500 iterations; 30 damping trials; relative improvement 1e-14; initial damping 1e-3; damping factor 10; floor 1e-12
rules.features: Gene Expression only; decreasing sample variance of log-normalized counts; ties by feature ID
rules.graph: UMAP fuzzy union a+b-a*b; local connectivity 1; bandwidth 1
rules.graphPruning: weights below maximum weight / epochs are omitted from UMAP optimization only; at 10 epochs use maximum weight / 500
rules.initialScale: largest absolute PCA coordinate to 10, then noise, then each axis to [0,10]
rules.map: UMAP; two dimensions; PCA initialization; serial SGD; PCG stream 0
rules.neighbors: exact; excludes self; ties by source barcode order; capped at retained cells minus one
rules.normalization: ln(1 + count / (all Gene Expression counts in cell / target)); before feature filtering
rules.pca: Householder tridiagonalization and implicit-shift QL; largest absolute loading positive
rules.scaling: center selected features; no variance scaling, clipping, whitening, regression or batch correction
